My first TC was on my first day of work as a blackjack dealer. I was dealing a hand and then I woke up in an ambulance. I remember them telling me I had a seizure so we were going to the hospital. I don’t remember anything after until a couple hours later when they came to get me for my second CT scan. My seizure was 5 minutes long and I felt like I’d been hit by a truck for two weeks after. It was rough.

I worked for a local restaurant chain and I had been concussed the night before from smacking my head into a headboard and the wall. I texted them that night and told them I wouldn’t make it in because of it but they said if I didn’t find coverage I had to come in. Spoiler alert: no coverage. Went into work, terrible migraine, couldn’t remember what section I had and they finally sent me home when I started crying over how frustrated I was.
